supersedes: pair-5892-freeze-v7 (kept). v8 per senior KAN-114 10693: record-integrity gates only (serialized readback enforced in live modes with a nonzero refusal and no grading eligibility; dry modes assert their expected outcome; exactly one evidence entry per executed attempt with unique ordered ids and valid patch hashes; final-attempt/candidate/captured-bytes linkage; evidence-unverified trials lose grading eligibility for every primary). No change to task, model, budgets, contract, images or benchmark outcomes; v1-v7 and the v6 correction kept
approved_by: KAN-114 comment 10693 (offline implementation and a no-environment, no-secret CI rehearsal only; no live smoke or pair is approved by this freeze)

shared.dependencies: the SAME reviewed deps-root-scripts-v1 entry for both arms (root prepare removed from the install copy only)
shared.network: agent container --network none + egress proxy (api.anthropic.com only), identical for both arms

independent_grader.calibration: KAN-111 run 43750792626 (axios-5892: 3x empty RESOLVED_NO, 3x gold RESOLVED_FULL)
independent_grader.when: after capture, outside the coding budget, in a job with no token

shared.final_patch: the exact captured bytes of each arm's LAST attempt
shared.stop_rules: usage limit / auth / host failure: stop, INFRA_INTERRUPTION, no automatic retry; budget reached: grade the existing patch; preflight failure: refuse
shared.briefing_guard: every attempt: refused if it carries a FAIL_TO_PASS name, a gold/test-patch line, or any other grader test name NOT verified in the pinned visible suite (identity sha256(file+NUL+name) in visible-identities-5892.json; 28 of 30 PASS_TO_PASS verify); counts only
shared.run_order: arm A first, then arm B on a fresh runner; B never receives A output, history or grade; both graded only after both trial jobs finish; one trial per arm; no automatic replacement (operational order, not counterbalanced)
shared.smoke_acceptance: lib/pilot/pair.js smokeProblems: verified attempt, served claude-opus-5-5, api_key_source none, provider firstParty, is_using_overage false, no change

evidence.per_attempt: agent/runner.js records each attempt: attempt id, classifyAttempt outcome/flags/reasons, parsed report (requested/served model, CLI, provider, apiKeySource, overage), agent-stage ms, patch sha256; lib/pilot/pair.js attemptEvidence/evidenceProblems/applyEvidence for BOTH arms
evidence.stop: lib/qb-pipeline.js: an attempt whose evidence outcome is not verified/coding_timeout ends the repair loop (event pilot.evidence_stop)
evidence.never_verified_without_evidence: a trial whose per-attempt evidence fails is incomplete_evidence (never execution_verified), patch_use diagnostic_only, grade_now false; live: stop_batch
evidence.top_level_model: pairSummary model/billing_route only from verified per-attempt evidence; never from profile.model
evidence.readback: bench/opus-pilot/pair.mjs reads the published pair-<arm>.json back and gates it with recordProblems (notice pair-evidence-<arm>)

shared.test_outcome_naming: diagnostics.last_report.raw_channel_verification (raw research-Mocha verdict) vs policy_adjusted_test_outcome (frozen exceptions / isolation re-checks applied); mapping in test/unit/pair-5892-v7-verdict-mapping.test.js

arm_b.route: lib/pilot/pair.js runArmB -> lib/qb-pipeline.js runPipeline -> orchestrate -> execute -> runAgentSandboxed
arm_b.shared_coding_allowance: one 1,800 s allowance across all attempts (agentTimeMs); no attempt starts once it is spent
qb_only: QB briefing built from contract v4 (task text + reviewed criteria; checks never in the briefing)
QB repair feedback between attempts (QB-10 routing; no-progress stop)
research-Mocha visible channel (advisory) + the 6 reviewed checks on each candidate
QB's own verdict decides whether to retry; it is never the benchmark score

not_frozen_here.bench/opus-pilot/approvals.json: the live gate: paired_route must be confirmed by the owner (separately from arm-A batch 1) before any live run
